extraction.notes: Three months ended 9/30/2023 column. Starts from net income available to common shareholders; subtotals and per-share figures tie (FFO 20,757 and Core FFO 21,724; 20,917/18,246 = $1.15 and 21,884/18,246 = $1.20 on the diluted basis). Company does not present an AFFO metric, so AFFO fields are null. Zero-valued lines (dashes) are included at 0. Technology implementation costs were classed as 'other' since it is a two-year technology implementation, not clearly severance or software transition; amount is 0 for the quarter. Capital expenditures per apartment home ($389, same-store, quarter, S-16 p.16) are total capex, not a recurring/maintenance split, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Diluted FFO and Core FFO per-share figures use the diluted total that adds back preferred dividends (160), which is not part of the subtotals recorded here.
